ocr.markdown:
Here's what's cookin': Garden Vegetable Dip
Recipe from the kitchen of: Jane Frank  Serves:
2 c. creamed cottage cheese
4 tbsp. skim milk
2 tbsp green pepper, chopped
2 tbsp chopped green onion
2 tbsp chopped radish
Beat cottage cheese with milk
in blender, till real creamy
Stir in rest of ingredients &
chill 1 hr. Suggested
seasoning: Dry soup
mix or ranch dressing
mix .
